title: Digital arrest: retiree sends ₹1.5 lakh by RTGS to a brand-new account
story: A retired teacher is kept on a Skype 'court hearing' for over two hours and told to deposit his savings for 'fund verification' or be arrested today.
why: ₹1.5 lakh to an account opened weeks ago, after an FD break, during a 140-minute internet call from an unknown number. He has a trusted contact, so a trusted check or hold is the right response.
